text: After the cry: Holmes says it is all over, and that they will enter Dr. Roylott's room
why: ¶240 states that Holmes says 'It means that it is all over' and then tells Watson they will enter Dr. Roylott's room.

text: Who gave the horrible cry? — a hoarse yell of pain, fear and anger, on which Holmes at once makes for Dr. Roylott's room
why: ¶238 describes the cry as 'a hoarse yell of pain and fear and anger', and ¶240 has Holmes head for Dr. Roylott's room. The question of who cried out is one a reader could reasonably ask, and the label does not name anyone.
